design.name: 九尾狐巫·铜镜
design.brief: The fox priestess's round bronze mirror, modelled separately: it floats in front of her by magic.
design.turnaround_pose: , standing upright on its edge: a thick round bronze disc, the FRONT face a smooth polished pale bronze-silver mirror surface, the BACK carved with a frosted cloud-and-beast pattern in verdigris with a big round jade knob in the centre painted as opaque bright cyan (no halo), a thick rim; chunky simplified game-art forms with clean bevelled edges, same colours and stylization as the mirror on the design sheet
design.turnaround_digits: The whole disc and the knob fully inside the frame; in the side views the thick edge profile and the knob sticking out of the back must be clearly readable.
